summary: One work item of a board as a side panel's tab holds it, in two parts that work together. BoardItemPanel: a head with the item's code over its title and a line of its column's chip and its labels, then its description, its fields, its checklist and its activity, each a section of its own (parts/detail-pane's sections), drawn only when given. BoardChecklist: the checklist as such a section, its heading saying the steps done of the steps in all, a bar filled as far, and each step a checkbox field that ticks it, a done step's words struck through and quiet. The checklist is held from outside: a tick calls onStepChange; without it the steps are read only.

anatomy.head: The item's head (PaneHeader at size lg): padded 16 across and 12 down and up, at least density.panel-head tall, a 1px rule in border under it; the code, the title and the chips in a column 8 apart.
anatomy.code: With code: the item's code over its title, such as HRB-142, in the code face, cut short.
anatomy.title: The item's title, the h2, wrapping and breaking long words, in the heading face.
anatomy.chips: With state or labels: the column's chip, then the labels, in a row that wraps, 6 apart.
anatomy.stateChip: The column the item stands in: a chip (parts of Badge, secondary) with the column's icon before its label.
anatomy.section: Each of description, fields, checklist and activity: a section as parts/detail-pane draws one (padded 16 by 12, its small heading, a rule under it, none under the last), drawn only when given and not empty.
anatomy.heading: A section's heading: parts/detail-pane's, the checklist's with its steps done of the steps in all after the title.
anatomy.description: The Description section's prose, wrapping evenly, on lines 24 tall.
anatomy.fields: The Fields section's terms beside their values, the term column as wide as the longest term (parts/detail-pane's facts).
anatomy.checklist: BoardChecklist: a section headed words.checklist.title with the steps done and the steps in all (Checklist 2/4); the bar, then the steps.
anatomy.progress: The bar, named words.checklist.progress: a track 4 tall in muted, fully round, filled in primary as far as the share of steps done; its value said as a percent.
anatomy.fill: The progress bar's fill, as far along as the steps done of the steps in all.
anatomy.steps: The steps in a list, reaching 4 into the section's padding on each side so the boxes line up with the heading.
anatomy.step: One step: a checkbox field, the whole row its label, so a press anywhere on it ticks the box.
anatomy.box: The step's checkbox: 16 square, 2 under the row's top, its check 14 in it.
anatomy.stepLabel: The step's words beside the box; while done, in muted-foreground and struck through (CheckboxField quiet checked).
anatomy.activity: The Activity section: what happened to the item, oldest first, as a timeline.

code.does: The item's code over its title.

state.does: The column it stands in: { label, icon? }, drawn as a chip.

labels.does: Its labels on the chips' line, such as BoardLabels.

description.does: What the item is about, as prose; its section is drawn only when given.

fields.does: Its fields as terms beside values: project, assignee, due date, reporter.

checklist.does: Its steps, { text, done }; the section is drawn only when it has steps.

onChecklistChange.does: Hears a step ticked or unticked, by its place in the checklist; without it the steps are read only.

activity.does: What happened to it, oldest first (TimelineEvent).

head.note: At least this tall; the code, the title and the chips 8 apart.

heading.note: parts/detail-pane's heading: text.xs at weight 500, as its paint says; uppercase, tracked wide.

stepsInset.note: The steps reach this far past the section's padding on each side.

boxTop.note: The box's offset from the row's top, so it sits on the label's first line.

rest.means: The head and every section given; a step not done, its box empty.

hover.means: The pointer is over a step: the row washed hover.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a step's box: the focus outline in ring, focus-ring-width wide, focus-ring-offset off.

checked.means: A step done: the box filled primary with a check in primary-foreground, the words in muted-foreground and struck through.
checked.reached: done on a step, or a press on it

readOnly.means: Without onChecklistChange: every box is disabled, the step's row at disabled-opacity, its box with it and not again on its own, the row's cursor not-allowed.

rest.note: 1 wide under the head; no ground of its own.
1 wide under each section but the last.
In the ink of what it stands on.

keyboard.does: Moves from one step's box to the next.
keyboard.when: the checklist is not read only

appText.title: The item's title.
appText.activity: Each event's title, time and detail.

sokkel-ui: A step's box is PlainCheckbox, a native button with role checkbox, so the panel loads none of Base UI's checkbox.

The words are default objects, exported as BOARD_ITEM_PANEL_WORDS and BOARD_CHECKLIST_WORDS (title a function of the steps done and in all), merged under words; BoardItemPanel passes words.checklist to BoardChecklist.

drift.today: As of 1a87987 there is no board item panel or checklist.
